steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to Adam north of the Wendlewick market.

steps.title: Rumors
steps.text: Talk to Raz in her house between Highweald Forest and Hollow Hill.

postconditions.text: see if I can find it

steps.text: Inspect the dead bear to the north.
Talk to Bartender Gefen in the Wendlewick tavern.
Talk to Miriam outside of the tavern.

steps.title: To the farm
steps.text: Talk to Farmer Rachel at the Eastfold Farm.
Investigate the bloodsplatter to the north at the broken fence
Enter the cave entrance to the north-east.

actions.text: What do I need to do?

steps.text: Climb to the top of the Wendlewick lighthouse.

steps.title: Gathering ingredients
steps.text: Pick the Wendlewick poppy at the top of the hill.
Wolf's tongue mushrooms next to fairy ring.
Kill a hedgehog west of the Shrine of Inanna.
Climb to the top of the Wendlewick lighthouse.

steps.title: Antisanguine potion
steps.text: Take a vial from the vial cabinet.
Use the vial of oil on the fireplace.
Mix the curshed hedgehog spine with the vial of oil.
Take from the sack of flowers.
Press the poppy on the table.
Mix the pressed poppy with the vial of oil.

postconditions.displayName: Vial of oil (crushed hedgehog spine, pressed Wendlewick poppy)

steps.text: Take a wolf's tongue from the sack of mushrooms.
Mix the wolf's tongue with the vial of oil.

actions.displayName: Vial of oil (crushed hedgehog spine, pressed Wendlewick poppy)

steps.title: Field testing
steps.text: Test the antisanguine potion on a hedgehog south of the Shrine of Inanna.
Test the antisanguine potion on the duck.
Use the antisanguine potion on a badger to the north-east.

steps.title: Getting a silver weapon
steps.text: Talk to Liat at the Wendlewick smithy.
Talk to Gidon at the Highweald Forest mine to the north.
Enter the new cave entrance in the Highweald Forest mine.
Smelt the ores into havensilver bars.

steps.title: The heart
steps.text: Talk to Anya at the cave east of Marigold Farm.
steps.warning: Make sure you have your antisanguine potion.

actions.text: I have no reason not to trust her

steps.text:
Fight the Sanguine heart.
  • The heart is invulnerable when tumors spawn.
  • Avoid the exploding pustules.
